_comment: DO NOT EDIT: FILE GENERATED FOR PTERODACTYL PANEL - PTERODACTYL.IO
name: ANDLINE Monolith
author: xypexxypex@list.ru
description: Pterodactyl runtime tailored for ZinovevEzCode/andline: Laravel 13, Vue 3 + Laravel Mix, Materio admin build, AndBridge gateway on 127.0.0.1:9443. Public nginx proxies /bridge-admin and /bridge-live; the plugin path stays private. Queue, scheduler, local PostgreSQL 17 + TimescaleDB and optional Newt/Pangolin.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
mkdir -p /mnt/server/www /mnt/server/logs /mnt/server/tmp
echo '[ANDLINE] Runtime directories created. App clone/update happens at runtime startup.'

variables.name: Git repository
variables.description: ANDLINE application repository.

variables.name: Git branch
variables.description: ANDLINE branch to deploy.

variables.name: Git token
variables.description: GitHub token required for the private ANDLINE repository.

variables.name: Auto pull
variables.description: Synchronize with origin/GIT_BRANCH on every server start.

variables.name: Force build
variables.description: Force Composer/npm rebuild even if the Git commit is unchanged.

variables.name: Build frontend
variables.description: Run root Vue/Laravel Mix build when a new Git revision is deployed. Set 0 to skip site assets.

variables.name: Build admin
variables.description: Run Materio admin Mix build when a new Git revision is deployed. Set 0 on a site-only/dev server to skip the slow admin npm ci + webpack.

variables.name: Force npm ci
variables.description: Force npm ci even when package-lock.json is unchanged and node_modules already exists.

variables.name: Composer path fallback
variables.description: ANDLINE lock currently contains local Windows path packages. If normal install fails, resolve the same constraints from public Composer repositories.

variables.name: Root frontend build
variables.description: ANDLINE public Vue/Laravel Mix production build command.

variables.name: Admin build
variables.description: ANDLINE Materio admin Laravel Mix production build command.

variables.name: Application environment
variables.description: Laravel APP_ENV.

variables.name: Application debug
variables.description: Laravel APP_DEBUG. Keep false in production.

variables.name: Application URL
variables.description: Public ANDLINE HTTPS URL used by Laravel.

variables.name: Run migrations
variables.description: Run php artisan migrate --force on startup.

variables.name: Run seeders
variables.description: Run php artisan db:seed --force. Enable only when you intentionally want seed data.

variables.name: Laravel optimize
variables.description: Rebuild Laravel production caches after environment and migrations.

variables.name: Database driver
variables.description: Primary ANDLINE database connection.

variables.name: Database host
variables.description: MariaDB/MySQL host.

variables.name: Database port
variables.description: MariaDB/MySQL port.

variables.name: Database name
variables.description: ANDLINE primary database.

variables.name: Database username
variables.description: ANDLINE primary database user.

variables.name: Database password
variables.description: ANDLINE primary database password.

variables.name: Timescale host
variables.description: TimescaleDB/PostgreSQL host for telemetry and time-series data.

variables.name: Timescale port
variables.description: TimescaleDB/PostgreSQL port.

variables.name: Timescale database
variables.description: TimescaleDB database name.

variables.name: Timescale username
variables.description: TimescaleDB database user.

variables.name: Timescale password
variables.description: TimescaleDB database password.

variables.name: Timescale SSL mode
variables.description: PostgreSQL sslmode for the timeseries connection.

variables.name: AndBridge gateway
variables.description: Start the Node.js gateway from /home/container/www/server.

variables.name: AndBridge gateway port
variables.description: Internal localhost-only AndBridge gateway port.

variables.name: AndBridge gateway path
variables.description: Private plugin WebSocket path on the Node gateway (not proxied by public nginx). Default /bridge-plugin.

variables.name: AndBridge gateway secret
variables.description: Shared secret used between the Node gateway and Laravel internal API.

variables.name: AndBridge private WSS URL
variables.description: Private URL for the Minecraft plugin (VPN/Newt/localhost), for example ws://127.0.0.1:9443/bridge-plugin. Do not put the public site hostname here.

variables.name: AndBridge collision mode
variables.description: Gateway session collision policy.

variables.name: Queue worker
variables.description: Start Laravel database queue worker.

variables.name: Scheduler
variables.description: Start Laravel schedule:work.

variables.name: Newt enabled
variables.description: Start Newt userspace tunnel client for Pangolin.

variables.name: Pangolin endpoint
variables.description: Pangolin URL, for example https://pangolin.example.com.

variables.name: Newt ID
variables.description: Newt site ID issued by Pangolin.

variables.name: Newt secret
variables.description: Newt site secret issued by Pangolin.

variables.name: TimescaleDB enabled
variables.description: Run the local PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB service. Persistent data: /home/container/timescaledb. Credentials are generated once in connection.env.

variables.name: TimescaleDB port
variables.description: Loopback-only database port; no external allocation required. Set before the first start.
